claims.statement: The Largest Contentful Paint API reports the render time of the largest image or text block visible within the viewport relative to navigation start.

proof.quote: The Largest Contentful Paint API reports the render time of the largest image or text block visible within the viewport relative to navigation start.

claims.statement: Interaction to Next Paint measures the latency from user input until the next frame is presented after all event handlers, layout, and paint complete.
